name: mtsport/product-prices
description: Adds MOC (Retail Recommended Price) and PMOC (Original RRP) custom price fields to the product admin Prices card.

description.en-GB: Adds MOC and PMOC price fields to the Prices card in product editing. Import via customFields.mtsport_moc and customFields.mtsport_pmoc (decimal).
description.sk-SK: Pridá polia MOC a PMOC do karty Ceny pri úprave produktu. Import cez customFields.mtsport_moc a customFields.mtsport_pmoc (desatinné číslo).
